bio:
Baptized 1757 at Tohickon Reformed Church, Bucks Co., to 'Casper Doll and Margaret [Dietz]'.

FamilySearch gives Anna Catharina's birth date as 1 Jan 1757 (baptized 22 Feb 1757 at Tohickon), her marriage in 1775 to Capt. Lewis Stecher Sr. (1743-1821), with children in Plainfield and Forks Twps from 1776, and her death in 1799. Find a Grave indexes her as 'Anna Catharine Doll Stacher' ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, Anna Catharine Doll (LH6M-WWW), with attached index entries (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/LH6M-WWW
